capabilities: Reopens closed tabs at their previous tab-bar position
Wraps the core Undo close tab command
Checks required internals exist and does nothing if missing
extras: Relies on undocumented Obsidian internals (recently closed tabs list and Undo close tab command); a future Obsidian update could stop it working, though it should not break anything. Author recommends Open Tab Settings and Tab Groups as compatible.
intentEvidence: Obsidian has no public API for this, so the plugin relies on a few internal parts of Obsidian
problem: Obsidian's Undo close tab command reopens closed tabs at the far right of the tab bar instead of where they were.
summary: Obsidian plugin that reopens closed tabs at their original tab-bar position instead of the far right.
